quests.title: Earth Explorer Mission
quests.description: Explore Earth's physical processes and understand our planet's systems!

story.introduction: The Earth Sciences Research Station needs your help to study various geographical phenomena affecting our planet!

steps.title: Plate Tectonics Investigation
steps.narrative: Dr. Terra shows you evidence of continental drift. Analyze the geological evidence!

problem.question: What evidence supports the theory of continental drift?
options: Similar rock formations on different continents
correct_answers: Similar rock formations on different continents
problem.explanation: Wegener's evidence included matching fossils, rock types, and the jigsaw-like fit of continents, supporting continental drift theory.
